qualifier: sperm-egg interaction, piRNA/epigenetic silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Fertilization, germline epigenetic silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members span gamete formation, sperm-zona/acrosome fertilization events, piRNA/KRAB/HUSH transposon silencing, imprinting and the maternal-to-zygotic transition; the fertilization steps separate it from the meiosis-rich confusable and the silencing/MZT content from the sperm-motility confusables.

core: Antiviral nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
qualifier: positive TRAF-IRF/NF-kB activation arm
name: Antiviral nucleic acid sensing activating type I interferon induction
rationale: All members concern RIG-I/MDA5, cytosolic DNA and TLR7/9 sensing driving IRF3/7 and NF-kB to produce type I IFN; it holds the activating arm, whereas confusables carry negative regulators of RIG-I and cGAS-STING.

qualifier: with inositol polyphosphate synthesis
name: PTEN-AKT signaling control and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation and loss, AKT activity and negative PI3K/AKT control alongside nuclear and cytosolic inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis; the PTEN/AKT arm distinguishes it from confusables limited to pyrophosphate hydrolysis or PAK-2 signaling.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fiber synthesis and metalloproteinase degradation
name: Collagen and elastic fiber matrix synthesis and degradation
rationale: Members span collagen and elastin biosynthesis, crosslinking, elastic fiber assembly and MMP-mediated collagen/elastin catabolism; confusables instead center on EMT, basement membrane or integrin-mediated matrix adhesion.

qualifier: anti-inflammatory IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37
name: Anti-inflammatory IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37 signaling
rationale: Members are signaling and regulation of the immunosuppressive cytokines IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37; confusables share the IL-27/IL-35 subunit context but add pro-inflammatory IL-12/IL-23, interferon or common-gamma-chain cytokines.

qualifier: maturation of rRNA, snoRNA and snRNA ends plus RNA surveillance
name: Exosome 3'-to-5' trimming of non-coding RNAs and RNA surveillance
rationale: Members are exosome-mediated 3' trimming of 5.8S rRNA, snoRNA and U4 snRNA together with 3'-to-5' mRNA decay and tRNA surveillance; confusables cover nuclear CUT/snRNA decay or Pol I/III transcription and endonucleolytic rRNA cleavage.

qualifier: entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: HIV entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover HIV binding, uncoating, reverse transcription, Env/Vpu synthesis and Nef/Vpu-mediated degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I with host restriction; confusables hold integration/Rev steps or PD-L1 and MHC-I antigen presentation.

core: Cortical neuron migration and forebrain axon tract formation
qualifier: reelin signaling and dendrite development
name: Reelin-guided cortical neuron migration and forebrain commissure formation
rationale: Members are cortical layering, radial and tangential migration, radial glia, and corpus callosum/anterior commissure/corticospinal tract morphogenesis; reelin signaling and dendrite development are what this theme has that the near-identical confusables lack.

qualifier: axonal kinesin transport and ER tubular network shaping
name: Kinesin-driven axonal organelle transport and ER tubule shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin and Miro (RHOT) mediated transport of mitochondria, vesicles and receptors in neurons plus ER tubular network formation and organelle tethering; confusables instead emphasize tubulin modification, microtubule severing or ER lipid transfer.

qualifier: apical surface localization
name: Polarized apical surface protein trafficking in epithelia
rationale: Members are Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport, apical localization, basolateral secretion and anion transport in polarized epithelia; the apical surface members distinguish it from CFTR-, exocyst/GLUT4- and lipid-flippase confusables.

qualifier: MRAS-SHOC2 complex
name: MRAS-SHOC2 complex-mediated RAF activation
rationale: All three members concern RAF activation, two via the MRAS-SHOC2 phosphatase complex, which separates it from confusables on BRAF/MAP2K mutants and ERK negative feedback.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and elongation
qualifier: promoter escape, pausing and HIV Tat-driven elongation
name: RNA polymerase II initiation, pausing and elongation, including HIV
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter escape, capping, pausing and elongation complex formation, much of it in HIV Tat-dependent form; confusables concern Pol I/III rRNA transcription, translational elongation or nuclear organization.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment formation and maintenance
name: Retinal neuron differentiation and photoreceptor outer segment maintenance
rationale: Members cover rod, cone, bipolar and amacrine differentiation, retinal layering and photoreceptor outer segment/ciliary transition zone organization; confusables cover gross eye morphogenesis, phototransduction or general ciliary trafficking.

qualifier: splice-isoform ligand binding and activating point mutants
name: FGFR isoform-specific ligand activation, activating mutants and adaptor cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 IIIb/IIIc ligand binding, FGFR2 splicing, activating point mutants and FRS/SHC/PLCG/PI3K cascades; confusables lack the isoform and mutant members and instead add Klotho co-receptors or Sprouty regulation.

qualifier: adenylyl cyclase/cAMP and CaMK routes, structural plasticity
name: Adenylyl cyclase and CaMK-driven CREB activation in synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members cover cAMP and CaMKII/IV routes to CREB phosphorylation with LTP/LTD, spine morphogenesis and synapse maturation; confusables center on NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling or neuronal RNA-binding translational control.

qualifier: aldosterone action on blood pressure
name: Regulation of aldosterone and cortisol synthesis and blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate mineralocorticoid and glucocorticoid biosynthesis, aldosterone secretion and response, and systemic arterial pressure; confusables carry renal sodium handling, CYP enzyme defects or renin-angiotensin signaling.

qualifier: vasopressin-dependent
name: Vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption
rationale: All members concern vasopressin action on renal water absorption and urine volume, including AVP defects causing diabetes insipidus; confusables cover aldosterone/sodium, aquaporin glycerol transport or renin-angiotensin.

qualifier: host cell invasion and phagosome maturation subversion
name: Intracellular bacterial invasion and phagosome maturation subversion
rationale: Members cover Listeria and Mtb entry, phagosome acidification and lysosome fusion and their pathogen blockade, iron acquisition and suppression of host defenses; confusables center on complement and antimicrobial peptides or toxins and anti-inflammatory signaling.

qualifier: RHOF GTPase
name: RHOF-mediated regulation of filopodium assembly
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of filopodium assembly and the RHOF GTPase cycle; confusables concern ephrin repulsion, dendrite arborization or postsynaptic actin.

core: Type I interferon antiviral response signature
qualifier: negative feedback and dengue immune modulation
name: Type I interferon signature, negative feedback and dengue modulation
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/antiviral transcriptional signatures, negative regulation of RIG-I and antiviral defense, and dengue modulation of immunity; the dengue members are absent from all confusables, which emphasize sensing, cGAS-STING or ISG effectors.

qualifier: WNT5A/Ca2+ and retinal/brain vascular barrier formation
name: WNT5A-Ca2+ signaling and blood-retinal barrier vascular formation
rationale: Members cover WNT5A-driven Frizzled internalization and Wnt/Ca2+ signaling together with retinal vessel, blood-retina and blood-brain barrier formation; confusables cover eye morphogenesis, Wnt secretion, planar cell polarity or canonical signaling.

qualifier: prostate epithelium
name: Androgen receptor signaling in prostate epithelium
rationale: All members concern androgen/testosterone response and AR transcription in prostate luminal epithelium; confusables are estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling.

qualifier: neutrophil antimicrobial proteins
name: Neutrophil antimicrobial protein defense against bacteria
rationale: Members cover antibacterial defense, neutrophil killing of Gram-negative bacteria, peptidoglycan targeting and metal sequestration by antimicrobial proteins; confusables add antifungal cytolysis or mucosal agglutination.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA and glucokinase regulation of glycogen
name: Glucagon-PKA and glucokinase control of glycogen metabolism
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA signaling, glycogenolysis and glycogen synthesis regulation and glucokinase regulation; confusables center on ChREBP/gluconeogenesis, insulin secretion or insulin action.

core: Viral genome integration and host control of viral transcription
qualifier: latency and retroelement silencing
name: Viral DNA integration, latency and host transcriptional silencing
rationale: Members span retroviral integration and PIC import, HCMV events, viral latency and host activation/suppression of viral transcription including KRAB-ZFP, HUSH and ChAHP silencing; confusables hold HIV entry/reverse transcription or RNA-virus replication.
